question: Mahavir Jayanti celebrates the birthday of Lord Mahavira who is the _______ Tirthankara of Jainism.
solution:
The correct answer is __*24th*__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Lord Mahavira is the last and 24th Tirthankara of Jainism.
 
• The festival usually falls in March or April, according to the Gregorian calendar
 
• Birth: Born in 540 BCE in Kundagrama, Bihar, India.
 
• Parents: Father - Siddhartha, Mother - Trishala.
